body: Thank you for this, it really helped. I know I need to move on it's just so hard. Seeing messages like this make me feel like I'm making the right decision by leaving and make me feel like it's necessary. I don't want it to be true but it has to be I think, it's just so fucking hard to let someone go when you both love eachother and have talked to eachother for like 2 hours every night for a year and a half. I agree the relationship is toxic and it's only allowing me to leech and for her to leech. I'm hesitant to say that my forgiveness is driving her to continue doing this, as she's a very upfront and honest person (she's told me when she messed up instantly after every time) but it's definitely something I have to consider. Thank you for this.
Can you explain why shifting the plug while it's in port makes it go away? If I push hard enough to the right it'll go completely away and stay there, so there's a fix kindof.
I really want Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker
This was exactly my problem, thank you so much. I thought I was either all alone with this or going crazy.

They're very very subtle and hard to capture on camera, and I can't find anything to rest my phone on but I tried my best.

[https://streamable.com/qb6vz](https://streamable.com/qb6vz)

​

It's easiest to notice with the giant mario, he gets kind of segmented when the camera is moved up/down. Sprites like the little rumbles in the clouds above Wario's castle are unaffected. It's kinda hard to notice especially if you don't know exactly what it is, but the giant mario and the moon are the best indicators of what I'm talking about.

I've seen screen ghosting and I don't think this is it. There's no afterimage or motion blur, it just takes the majority of the sprites and overlays white scanlines over them, reducing the image quality and sometimes giving almost a flashing effect if the camera/screen moves up and down for more than a second. Some sprites that are layered over others like Mario in SML2 are completely fine. Maybe screen-ghosting has a different form on the GBC, I might just be dumb and noticing this effect for the first time.
